name: Gracen Newton
bio: Gracen Newton is an American child/teen actor and voice actor. He has acted in General Hospital, Will & Grace, Fear Street, The Patrick Star Show, Side Hustle, Dogs in Space, Rumble, and Diary of a Wimpy Kid.

credits.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid Christmas: The Getaway
credits.overview: With the stress of the holidays fast approaching, the Heffley family – to Greg's dismay – makes a last-minute decision to escape to an all-inclusive island resort for some much-needed rest and relaxation. As hilarious hijinks ensue, the Heffleys soon discover that paradise may not be everything it's cracked up to be.

credits.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: The Last Straw
credits.overview: When laidback Greg finds himself at odds with his dad's outsized expectations, pressure builds to turn his act around. After a series of hilarious near disasters, Greg's dad presents him with an ultimatum that just might challenge his wimpy ways for good.

credits.title: Dr. Seuss's The Sneetches
credits.overview: An unexpected friendship forms between two young Sneetches on an island surrounded by beaches in this sweet musical special set in the world of Seuss.

credits.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid Christmas: Cabin Fever
credits.overview: A hilarious and heartfelt holiday tale centered around everyone's favorite disaster-prone middle school student, Greg Heffley, which finds him desperately fighting to stay off Santa's naughty list as the family prepares for a major winter snowstorm.

credits.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Rodrick Rules
credits.overview: As a new school year begins, Greg is subject to relentless teasing from his brother Rodrick. Will Greg manage to get along with him? Or will a secret ruin everything?

credits.title: Bromates
credits.overview: Longtime best friends Sid and Jonesie are dumped by their respective girlfriends. Both without a living situation, they decide to become "bromates", bros who are roommates, which puts their relationship to the ultimate test.

credits.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid
credits.overview: Greg Heffley is a scrawny but ambitious kid with an active imagination and big plans to be rich and famous – he just has to survive middle school first.

credits.title: Rumble
credits.overview: In a world where monster wrestling is a global sport and monsters are superstar athletes, teenage Winnie seeks to follow in her father’s footsteps by coaching a loveable underdog monster into a champion.
